25818-the-first-mate-the-story-of-a-stra.title: The First Mate The Story Of A Strange Cruise
25818-the-first-mate-the-story-of-a-stra.creator: Unknown
25818-the-first-mate-the-story-of-a-stra.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. he deck of the vessel which I was scrutinising. It was afternoon of a grey day in the latter part of October three years ago; and the scene was one of the wharves of the east basin of the London Docks, round which I had been prowling in search of a ship.

arxiv-2012-09855.title: Infinite Nature:Perpetual View Generation of Natural Scenes from a Single Image
arxiv-2012-09855.creator: Andrew Liu Richard Tucker Varun Jampani
arxiv-2012-09855.description: Abstract We introduce the problem of perpetual view generation —long-range generation of novel views corresponding to an arbitrarily long camera trajectory given a single image. This is a challenging problem that goes far beyond the capabilities of current view synthesis methods, which quickly degenerate when presented with large camera motions.

arxiv-2102-04304.title: Identifying Influential Nodes in Weighted Networks using k-shell based HookeRank Algorithm Journal: Online Social Networks and Media
arxiv-2102-04304.creator: Nipun Aggarwal, Sanjay Kumar
arxiv-2102-04304.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nipun Aggarwal, Sanjay Kumar. Finding influential spreaders is a crucial task in the field of network analysis because of numerous theoretical and practical importance. These nodes play vital roles in the information diffusion process, like viral marketing. Many real-life networks are weighted networks, but relatively less work has been done for finding influential nodes in the case of weighted networks as compared to unweighted networks. In this paper, we propose k k -shell based HookeRank (KSHR) algorithm to identify spreaders in weighted networks.

arxiv-2205-08393.title: Full Duplex Massive MIMO Architectures: Recent Advances, Applications, and Future Directions Thanks: G. C. Alexandropoulos is with the Department of Informatics and Telecommunications, National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, Panepistimiopolis Ilissia, 15784 Athens, Greece (e-mail: alexandg@d
arxiv-2205-08393.creator: George C. Alexandropoulos, Md Atiqul Islam
arxiv-2205-08393.description: Abstract The increasingly demanding objectives for next generation wireless communications have spurred recent research activities on multi-antenna transceiver hardware architectures and relevant intelligent communication schemes. Among them belong the Full Duplex (FD) Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) architectures, which offer the potential for simultaneous uplink and downlink operations in the entire frequency band.

arxiv-2208-04635.title: Lang-n-Send Extended: Sending Regular Expressions to Monitors
arxiv-2208-04635.creator: Matteo Cimini
arxiv-2208-04635.description: Abstract In prior work, Cimini has presented Lang-n-Send , a π 𝜋 \pi -calculus with language definitions. In this paper, we present an extension of this calculus called Lang-n-Send +m fragments Lang-n-Send +m \textsc{Lang-n-Send}^{\texttt{+m}} . First, we revise Lang-n-Send to work with transition system specifications rather than its language specifications.

arxiv-2404-12924.title: Partial orders are the free conservative cocompletion of total orders
arxiv-2404-12924.creator: Calin Tataru
arxiv-2404-12924.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Calin Tataru. We show that the category of partially ordered sets 𝖯𝗈𝗌 \Pos is equivalent to the free conservative cocompletion of the category of finite non-empty totally ordered sets Δ \Delta , which is also known as the simplex category. 1
Introduction

Colimits are an important tool in category theory, allowing us to glue together objects in a category in a universal way. However, most categories do not have all colimits.

arxiv-2408-06158.title: OmniCLIP: Adapting CLIP for Video Recognition with Spatial-Temporal Omni-Scale Feature Learning
arxiv-2408-06158.creator: Mushui Liu, Bozheng Li, Yunlong Yu
arxiv-2408-06158.description: Abstract Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) e.g. CLIP have made great progress in video recognition. Despite the improvement brought by the strong visual backbone in extracting spatial features, CLIP still falls short in capturing and integrating spatial-temporal features which is essential for video recognition.

arxiv-2408-11709.title: SynradG4: A Geant4-Based Extension for Synchrotron Radiation Background Studies in the ePIC Detector at the Electron-Ion Collider
arxiv-2408-11709.creator: Andrii Natochii
arxiv-2408-11709.description: Abstract The Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) will operate at high luminosity with multi-GeV, high-current electron beams, resulting in substantial synchrotron radiation (SR) emission in the electron storage ring (ESR). A detailed understanding of SR photon transport in the complex three-dimensional interaction region (IR) geometry is critical for estimating backgrounds in the ePIC detector and for developing effective shielding and masking strategies.

arxiv-2409-13908.title: Nonlinear Inverse Design of Mechanical Multi-Material Metamaterials Enabled by Video Denoising Diffusion and Structure Identifier
arxiv-2409-13908.creator: Jaewan Park 1,2, Shashank Kushwaha 1, Junyan He 1, Seid Koric 1,2, Qibang Liu 2,3, Iwona Jasiuk 1, Diab Abueidda 2,4
arxiv-2409-13908.description: Abstract Metamaterials, synthetic materials with customized properties, have emerged as a promising field due to advancements in additive manufacturing. These materials derive unique mechanical properties from their internal lattice structures, which are often composed of multiple materials that repeat geometric patterns.

arxiv-2410-21169.title: Document Parsing Unveiled: Techniques, Challenges, and Prospects for Structured Data Extraction
arxiv-2410-21169.creator: Qintong Zhang, Bin Wang, Victor Shea-Jay Huang, Junyuan Zhang, Zhengren Wang, Hao Liang, Conghui He, Wentao Zhang
arxiv-2410-21169.description: Abstract . Document parsing (DP) transforms unstructured or semi-structured documents into structured, machine-readable representations, enabling downstream applications such as knowledge base construction and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This survey provides a comprehensive and timely review of document parsing research. We propose a systematic taxonomy that organizes existing approaches into modular pipeline-based systems and unified models driven by Vision-Language Models (VLMs).

arxiv-2412-10321.title: AdvPrefix: An Objective for Nuanced LLM Jailbreaks
arxiv-2412-10321.creator: Sicheng Zhu, Brandon Amos, Yuandong Tian, Chuan Guo, Ivan Evtimov
arxiv-2412-10321.description: Abstract Many jailbreak attacks on large language models (LLMs) rely on a common objective: making the model respond with the prefix “Sure, here is (harmful request)”. While straightforward, this objective has two limitations: limited control over model behaviors, yielding incomplete or unrealistic jailbroken responses, and a rigid format that hinders optimization.

arxiv-2502-21143.title: Variational Bayesian Pseudo-Coreset
arxiv-2502-21143.creator: Hyungi Lee, Seungyoo Lee, Juho Lee
arxiv-2502-21143.description: Abstract The success of deep learning requires large datasets and extensive training, which can create significant computational challenges. To address these challenges, pseudo-coresets, small learnable datasets that mimic the entire data, have been proposed. Bayesian Neural Networks, which offer predictive uncertainty and probabilistic interpretation for deep neural networks, also face issues with large-scale datasets due to their high-dimensional parameter space.

arxiv-2504-15205.title: Support Evaluation for the TREC 2024 RAG Track: Comparing Human versus LLM Judges
arxiv-2504-15205.creator: Nandan Thakur, Ronak Pradeep, Shivani Upadhyay, Daniel Campos, Nick Craswell, Jimmy Lin
arxiv-2504-15205.description: Abstract Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to generate answers with citations from source documents containing “ground truth”, thereby reducing system hallucinations. A crucial factor in RAG evaluation is “support”—whether the information in the cited documents supports the answer.

arxiv-2509-15604.title: Spin-Orbital Altermagnetism
arxiv-2509-15604.creator: Zi-Ming Wang, Yang Zhang, Song-Bo Zhang, Jin-Hua Sun, Elbio Dagotto, Dong-Hui Xu, Lun-Hui Hu
arxiv-2509-15604.description: Abstract Altermagnet is a newly discovered magnetic phase, characterized by non-relativistic spin-splitting that has been experimentally observed. Here, we introduce a framework dubbed spin-orbital altermagnetism to achieve spin-orbital textures in altermagnetic materials. We identify two distinct classes of spin-orbital altermagnetism: intrinsic and extrinsic.

arxiv-2601-00304.title: Combining Time-Series and Graph Data: A Survey of Existing Systems and Approaches Thanks: This paper is submitted to SIGMOD Record.
arxiv-2601-00304.creator: Mouna Ammar, Marvin Hofer, Erhard Rahm
arxiv-2601-00304.description: Abstract We provide a comprehensive overview of current approaches and systems for combining graphs and time series data. We categorize existing systems into four architectural categories and analyze how these systems meet different requirements and exhibit distinct implementation characteristics to support both data types in a unified manner.

arxiv-2601-17854.title: How many points contain homothetic copies in their Hurwitz continued fraction expansion? Thanks: Keywords : continued fraction; Hausdorff dimension; iterated function system
arxiv-2601-17854.creator: Yuto Nakajima and Hiroki Takahasi
arxiv-2601-17854.description: Abstract . We prove that the set of complex irrationals whose partial quotients in their Hurwitz continued fraction expansion are naturally regarded as subsets of ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}^{2} and contain infinitely many homothetic copies of any finite subset of ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}^{2} is of Hausdorff dimension 1 1 .

However, recent evidence suggests that doses of ionizing radiation (IR) delivered inside the tumor target volume, during fractionated radiotherapy, can promote tumor invasion and metastasis. Furthermore, the tissues that s

pmc-10566263.title: Clinical presentation of monkeypox in patients with different HIV serostatus – two cases from Bulgaria: A case report
pmc-10566263.creator: Daniel Toshkov Ivanov, Nina Stoyanova Yancheva, Trifon Kostadinov Valkov
pmc-10566263.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Monkeypox is an emerging zoonosis that has been declared a public health threat due to its spread outside of endemic areas. We present two cases of monkeypox: one involving a 39-year-old male patient living with HIV on antiretroviral therapy with detectable viraemia and a low CD4 count, and another involving a 44-year-old male, negative for HIV, who visited our Diagnostic and Consultative Unit with a new-onset skin rash.

pmc-11630509.title: Genomic instability in non–breast or ovarian malignancies of individuals with germline pathogenic variants in BRCA1/2
pmc-11630509.creator: Lisa Elze, Rachel S van der Post, Janet R Vos, Arjen R Mensenkamp, Samhita Pamidimarri Naga, Juliet E Hampstead, Emma Vermeulen, Michiel Oorsprong, Tom Hofste, Michiel Simons, Iris D Nagtegaal, Nicoline Hoogerbrugge, Richarda M de Voer, Marjolijn J L Ligtenberg
pmc-11630509.description: BackgroundIndividuals with germline pathogenic variants in BRCA1 or BRCA2 are at a high risk of breast and ovarian carcinomas with BRCA1/2 deficiency and homologous recombination deficiency that can be detected by analysis of genome-wide genomic instability features such as large-scale state transitions, telomeric allelic imbalances, and genomic loss of heterozygosity.

pmc-12663524.title: Utilizing functional neuroimaging to study early language development
pmc-12663524.creator: Halie A. Olson, Trevor K.M. Day, Kelly J. Hiersche, Brittany L. Manning, Holly Bradley, Soujin Choi, Gavkhar Abdurokhmonova, Sarah A. McCormick, Amy L. Conrad, Dustin Scheinost, Kelly A. Vaughn
pmc-12663524.description: Language develops rapidly over the infant and toddler period and has been a key area of research within the field of developmental cognitive neuroscience. Understanding the neural basis of early language development may help us predict delays or disorders, recommend early interventions, and provide a deeper mechanistic understanding of how the brain supports language learning.

pmc-12678656.title: Exploring the influence of social media ‘Mumfluencers’ on postpartum body image
pmc-12678656.creator: Georgia Gibson, Caitlin Liddelow, Karena J. Burke, Megan F. Lee
pmc-12678656.description: Social media is an external influence thought to notably impact body image. There is limited research to date exploring whether the rise of social media ‘Mumfluencers’ – women who gain large social media followings by sharing their experiences of motherhood – positively or negatively influence postpartum body image and wellbeing.

pmc-13456189.creator: Eloise Violet Kwan, Jessie Adams, Joanna Macdonald, Susan Brumby, Tracey Hatherell, Feby Savira, Alison Kennedy

pmc-13562729.title: A gapless 100 m resolution daily mean land surface temperature dataset over the Tibetan Plateau in 2019
pmc-13562729.creator: Xiaoxiao Kong, Yingbao Yang, Penghua Hu, Xin Pan, Zhenwei Wang, Xinyi Lu, Yang Dai
pmc-13562729.description: The Tibetan Plateau (TP), known as the “Third Pole”, is highly sensitive to climate change. Fine-scale daily mean land surface temperature (DMLST) data are needed to study regional climate processes, permafrost dynamics, glacier melt, and land surface energy balance. However, existing DMLST products over the TP generally have spatial resolutions of 1 km to 0.

pmc-13579857.title: Anticancer proteasome inhibitors are detrimental to the growth of Toxoplasma gondii in vitro
pmc-13579857.creator: Meir Zhang, Pascale S Guiton
pmc-13579857.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveToxoplasma gondii is a globally widespread intracellular protozoan that infects an estimated 25% of the world’s human population. There is currently no cure for chronic toxoplasmosis, and treatments for acute infection often cause harmful side effects.

pmc-13675904.title: B Cell Deficiency Protects Against the Development of c‐MET and Beta‐Catenin Driven Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Mice
pmc-13675904.creator: Fang Wang, Eun Bi Lim, Rehan Mehta, Yee Ling Wu
pmc-13675904.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), a lethal form of liver cancer, continues to show rising mortality rates despite advancements in immunotherapies. This highlights the need for more effective treatments. Recent studies linked the presence of B cells within human tumors, including HCC, to improved responses to immunotherapy and better prognoses.
